# Lightenette assets

[한국어](ASSETS-KO.md)

Every graphic, font, 3D model, sound effect and piece of music in Lightenette is
**generated by code in this repository at build time**. No images, fonts, recordings
or scores are taken from anywhere else, and no CC0 assets are used. All assets below
are original work under the same copyright and licence as the source:
**Apache-2.0** (Copyright 2026 Corvane contributors).

The generator is `tools/mkassets.py`; the code that draws, synthesises and lays out
lives in `tools/cvtools/` (shared with corvane). The same source always produces the
same bytes.

The PNG files in `docs/images/` (if any) are README screenshots captured from the
built ROM. They are documentation, not assets: the build never reads them and they
are not in the ROM.

| File (output) | Contents | Generator | Source / licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cv_font_tiles` | 5x7 pixel font (ASCII 0x20–0x5F), 4bpp | `cvtools/font.py` `GLYPHS` (glyphs drawn as strings) | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_ui_tiles`, `cv_ui_pal` | window frame and gauge tiles | `images.ui_tiles()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_sprite_tiles`, `cv_sprite_pal` | small sprite sheet (shared with corvane; unused by the title) | `images.sprite_sheet()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_tex_*`, `cv_toon_table` | textures in all seven 3D formats, toon table (shared with corvane) | `images.textures()`, `toon_table()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_smp_*`, `cv_song_*`, `cv_sound_bank`, `cv_sample_names`, `cv_song_names` | sound effects and music | `cvtools/audio.py` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| (runtime) judge card texture and lantern sprite | 64x16 direct-colour paper card with cut lines; 64x64 4bpp radial glow | drawn at run time by `arm9/source/judge/judge.c` (`acc_make_card`, `acc_make_lamp`) | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `probe.bin` (NitroFS) | 2 KB known-CRC file the cart check reads | `tools/mkassets.py` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| banner icon (`icon.bmp`) | 32x32 4bpp icon | `images.icon()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
